description:
Read one marketplace REQUEST by id (GET /request/{id}; you must own it). Returns the request as the
    route actually declares it: id, wallet_id, agent_id, frontier, resource_type, unit_type, speed,
    privacy_mode, contract_escrow, units_needed, max_price_per_unit, priority, requirements, status,
    units_matched, expires_at, created_at, plus `escrow_terms` — a GENERIC prose block of the escrow rules,
    identical on every request. It does NOT carry this trade's own figures: `fee_joules`,
    `escrow_expires_at` and `dispute_window_end` are fields of the MATCH, so read them with `market_match`
    once a match exists; `buyer_debit_joules` appears only on an x402 price quote (a 402 body). Bearer
    required.

request_id.description: The marketplace REQUEST id (UUID) you posted with `market_request`.
request_id.title: Request Id

name: market_quote

outputSchema.description:
market_quote — RAREEAI RequestOut as the route actually declares it. `escrow_terms` is left
OPAQUE on purpose: a GENERIC prose block, identical on every request. This trade's own figures
(fee_joules, escrow_expires_at, dispute_window_end) live on MatchOut — the `market_match` payload —
and are not on this route, so they are not declared here (the tool docstring now says the same).

escrow_terms.description: generic escrow prose; opaque by design
escrow_terms.title: Escrow Terms

rematch_max_total_joules.description: the most a background re-match can lock from your wallet
rematch_max_total_joules.title: Rematch Max Total Joules

status.description: pending · partially_matched · matched (every unit covered, a match still awaits the provider's approval) · fulfilled · expired · cancelled
status.title: Status

outputSchema.title: RequestQuoteOut
